alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.note: Alerts aimed at a role you hold. The role shown is who the alert has reached, so an overdue item that has escalated is aimed at a higher role.
alerts.confirmBody: This records that you have seen it, under your name. It can be done once.
alerts.already: This alert was already acknowledged. The list will refresh.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: There is no metrics data to show.
dashboard.noneMissing: Every metric has a query behind it.

care.title: Care
care.changed: That changed in the meantime. Refresh and look again.
care.patientIdBad: That is not a patient id.

gaps.ageNotSet: The age at which an item is flagged overdue is not set, so nothing is flagged.
gaps.unreadable: These sources could not be read:
gaps.unknownLastDone: Recurrence rules whose last-done date is unknown

plans.note: A plan text is never shown here. A doctor writes a plan, the rules screen it, and it waits for a doctor to approve it. Nothing runs before then.
plans.writeBody: The rules screen the text first. It then waits for a doctor to approve it, and nothing runs before that.
plans.decideBody: Your decision is recorded under your name. Nothing runs before a plan is approved.
plans.decided: Recorded. The plan is now waiting for: {{waiting}}.
plans.written: The plan was submitted. It is now waiting for: {{waiting}}.
plans.notConfigured: Care plans are not set up yet. Nothing was written.

results.note: Results are append-only. To correct one, record a new result that names the one it replaces.
results.body: This records a result for the patient. It cannot be edited afterwards.
results.measuresHint: Leave a value empty if it is not known; it is recorded as unknown, never as zero.
results.notNumber: A value must be a number or empty.
results.zoneNote: Times are in the clinic time zone: {{zone}} (demo placeholder).
results.doneWake: The result was recorded. A waiting care plan will be woken.
